title: A large conversation begins with choice

captions.physics: Speaking of understanding still left open
captions.energy: Directing conversation towards a particular question
captions.emotions: Feeling the value of voluntary participation

meaning: You can speak of understanding still left open and direct conversation towards a particular question, feeling the value of participation each person chooses freely.
text: On your Vishuddha, the Star in the physical position appears in talking about the possibility of understanding each other better. The Chariot in energy supports a wish to direct conversation towards a particular question and give hope a substantial course. The Lovers in emotions bring significance to voluntary participation. A broad intention can gain a clear beginning without a compulsory unified outcome. A chosen direction helps address substance while preserving room for an answer not yet ready.

Suppose you say, “One day we will ask everything we could not find words for before”. For now, the conversation concerns what “being there” means. **A particular question leaves participation free**. You can discuss this meaning without immediately requiring every expectation to be described. Actual choice feels valuable: one answer is ready while another still needs words. Hope for further understanding depends neither on matching speed nor on a promise that important definitions will coincide.

Difficulty arises if the question becomes an argument against stopping: having begun something important supposedly means no part of the answer can wait. The chosen course replaces voluntary continuation. The constructive Chariot helps hold the subject and recognise directly where words are unavailable now. You can value direction without accelerating a response; substance is not measured by the amount disclosed, while mutuality allows a pause without abandoning hope for deeper understanding.
